rationale: Describes ABM orchestration and an engagement platform, but also relies on 'Account Intelligence' and 'intelligence and insight' with no described mechanism. The unexplained intelligence feature may be AI-dependent and the marketing language does not establish a conventional implementation, so the binary is weak and forced.
ai_type_rationale: Cross-channel orchestration across marketing and sales is described as the conventional core and would remain without the described intelligence layer. Whether the intelligence is core or an enhancement is unresolved, so enabled is a weak forced subtype.
evidence_spans: Inject Account Intelligence into every step of the B2B buyer journey
connects every source of intelligence and insight
ai_type_evidence_spans: orchestrate every action across marketing and sales
reinvents ABM around the customer experience
